messages:
inc-bot: [ALERT] 03:12 UTC - service=inference-runtime - error_rate spike (5xx) 12m rolling, likely kv-cache reuse path. Trace sample attached.

mike_oncall: saw it. errors spiking from 03:09. adding SRE oncall.

ana_sre: tagging in @ana_sre (SRE). can you paste the trace sample?

inc-bot: trace excerpt:
```
trace_id=tx-9a3c sample: kv_cache::reuse(): seq_offset mismatch: expected=1245 seen=2045 req_id=abc123 path=continuous-batch
stack: runtime/src/kv_cache.rs:412
context: batch_id=202003 user_prefix_len=18
```

ana_sre: thanks. this looks like stale seq offsets causing KV cache to return values belonging to prior request -> cross-request leakage.

sarah_eng: @mike_oncall do we have a quick kill switch for kv reuse? fallback to per-request caching?

mike_oncall: yes. config flag exists: inference.kv.cache_reuse. planning to flip to false in prod. prepping command.

mike_oncall: running: 
```
redwoodctl config set inference.kv.cache_reuse=false --env=prod --reason "incident - disable reuse to stop stale offsets"
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-rollout config/inference/kv-reuse -> prod (id: cfg-202-rollback). will notify on completion.

carla_support: quick note - CS reported one customer complaint about garbled completions around 03:10. flagged as high priority. CS is triaging customers affected.

dinesh_ml: ping - is continuous batching config changed recently? batch window reduced last week to improve latency. might be related.

sarah_eng: yes we tuned batch aggregation to be more aggressive. hypothesis: more aggressive batching exposed reuse path race, causing seq offsets to drift.

ana_sre: deploy-bot: config rollout complete. confirming: all runtime pods received new config.

deploy-bot: config rollout status: 100% success across prod runtime nodes.

mike_oncall: running smoke tests now. hitting a few endpoints, inspecting logs for seq mismatch.

mike_oncall: smoke: 20k requests, 0 seq_offset errors after disabling reuse. error rate down to baseline.

sarah_eng: great. can we put an emergency canary to re-enable with extra logging and limited pct after patch? or better to keep off and ship fix.

ana_sre: keep it off. need a code fix. will add guard to ensure kv entries include request_epoch token and solid seq validation before reuse.

dinesh_ml: reproducer attached (local): steps to trigger: send overlapping batched requests with differing prompt_prefix lengths, watch seq offsets increment unexpectedly. snippet:
```
# repro script (python)
# send 50 concurrent batched requests with prefix lengths warp
```

sarah_eng: assigning to eng-runtime runbook. @dinesh_ml to implement seq sanity check + add per-entry provenance tag. aim for hotfix branch.

mike_oncall: customer impact quick summary: approx 0.4% of requests in 03:08-03:12 window returned tokens from previous request (garbled). no PII observed. CS notified top 5 paying customers, offering credits.

carla_support: agreed. leaning on standard incident comms. drafting status update for affected customers.

sarah_eng: hotfix PR created: runtime/kv_cache: add seq_validation and provenance; also fallback to clone-on-read if mismatch. PR: https://git.internal/r/runtime/pull/4521

inc-bot: deploy pipeline queued for hotfix. CI includes heavy smoke with concurrent batches.

mike_oncall: plan: 1) keep kv reuse disabled in prod (mitigation) 2) merge & test hotfix in staging 3) deploy hotfix w/ canary 5% then 25% then 100% 4) re-evaluate re-enable reuse with strict provenance and logging 5) postmortem.

sarah_eng: timeline estimate: staging tests + review ~2h. emergency release window ~3-4h if CI passes.

ana_sre: adding post-incident pager and on-call handoff notes. will monitor 3h after deploy.

mike_oncall: handing off to @sarah_eng for follow-up. I'll stay on watch for 30m.

sarah_eng: taking it. keeping thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
